title: Trump is making it easier for fossil fuel companies to leak methane

claims.claim: Trump yonetimi metan sizintilarina karsi koruma kurallarini zayflatma planlarini bugun aciklamasi beklenmektedir.

evidence.quote: In its latest gift to oil and gas companies, the Trump administration is expected to announce plans today to weaken rules that guard against methane leaks.

claims.claim: Metan, 20 yillik bir ufukta karondioksitten 80 kat daha guclu olan bir sera gazidir.

evidence.quote: Methane is a smog-forming pollutant and a powerful greenhouse gas that’s up to 80 times as potent as carbon dioxide on a 20-year horizon.

claims.claim: EPA, Biden donemi kurallarini geri alarak metan emisyonlarini 14 yil icinde yuzde 80 oraninda azaltmasi beklenen kurallari degistirmeyi planlamaktadir.

evidence.quote: As part of President Donald Trump’s deregulatory agenda, the EPA plans to undo Biden-era rules that were expected to cut methane emissions by 80 percent over 14 years.

claims.claim: Metan, kuresel isinmanin yaklaşık yuzde 30'una neden olmustur.

evidence.quote: Methane has caused about 30 percent of global warming
Methane has caused about 30 percent of global warming so far.

claims.claim: EPA Yoneticisi Lee Zeldin, kural degisikliklerinin petrol ve gaz sirketlerine 45 milyar dolar tasarruf saglayacagini belirtmistir.

evidence.quote: EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin says the rollbacks will save oil and gas companies $45 billion, while the previous rules would have incurred $18 billion in regulatory costs.

claims.claim: Eski ve dusuk uretimli marjinal kuyular, ABD petrol ve gazinin yuzde 6'sini uretmesine ragmen sektorun metan emisyonlarinin yarisindan sorumludur.

evidence.quote: These wells are responsible for half of the industry’s methane emissions despite only producing 6 percent of US oil and gas, ProPublica reports.

claims.claim: EPA, saatte 100 kilogram veya daha fazla metan salinimini bildiren Super Emitter Programi'ni sonlandirmasi beklenmektedir.

evidence.quote: The EPA is also expected to end the Super Emitter Program that notified oil and gas infrastructure operators of large releases of methane reaching 100 kilograms per hour or more.

claims.claim: Trump'in aciklamayi bugun Teksas eyaletinin Lubbock sehrindeki bir secim mitinginden yapmasi beklenmektedir.

evidence.quote: Trump plans to make the announcement from a campaign rally in Lubbock, Texas, today, Bloomberg reports.
